---
description: "Accessible documentation and Vue components"
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md, docs/.vitepress/**/*.vue"
---

# Accessible documentation

Keep heading order, descriptive links, meaningful image descriptions and
keyboard-accessible custom Vue controls in the wiki. Preserve visible focus,
readable contrast and responsive layouts in the existing VitePress theme.
Check rendered navigation and changed interactive components before delivery;
Markdown source alone does not prove the rendered behavior.
